bio:
SpeedSlap is a Chrome extension for controlling YouTube playback speed the way you actually want to: configurable keyboard shortcuts, scroll wheel control, a draggable on-screen overlay, and a speed that persists between videos instead of resetting.

By Tront (Trent Sterling), who built it because the built-in speed menu was not enough.
